mapper.select: select r.discount_max_price as discountMaxPrice, i.discount as discount from tbl_dynamic_discount_rule r inner join tbl_dynamic_discount_city c on c.dynamic_discount_rule_id = r.id and c.is_delete = 0 inner join tbl_dynamic_discount_info i on i.dynamic_discount_rule_id = r.id and i.is_delete = 0 where r.is_unuse = 0 and c.city_code = #{cityCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and r.service_type = #{serviceTypeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and r.car_level = #{carLevelId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and r.valid_start_time <= now() and r.valid_end_time >= now() and ( (r.date_type = 1 and r.week_set like concat('%', #{startWeekDay,jdbcType=INTEGER}, '%')) or (r.date_type = 2 and r.special_date_set like concat('%', #{startDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')) ) and r.time_set like concat('%', #{startHour,jdbcType=INTEGER}, '%') and i.km <= #{totalDistance,jdbcType=DOUBLE} order by i.km desc limit 1
